description: A wave shaper built from two passes of a Peter de Jong equation, folding two inputs into two related outputs.

params.text: Amount of the second sine term in the shaping.
Amount of the first sine term in the shaping.
Amount of the third sine term in the shaping.
Amount of the fourth sine term in the shaping.
Rate of the first internal modulation of the shaping.
Rate of the second internal modulation of the shaping.
Bends the shaping curve on the left side.
Bends the shaping curve on the right side.
Sets the rate range the two internal modulations cover: up is the highest, middle is between, down is the slowest.

inputs.text: Audio into the left side of the shaper. With nothing patched here an internal modulation is shaped instead.
Audio into the right side of the shaper. With nothing patched here an internal modulation is shaped instead.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.
The module makes a sound with nothing patched in, because an empty audio input is replaced by an internal modulation source.
